items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: You ever hear Georgie Boyd playing? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Lots of good jazz clarinetes playing... Oh, Georgie Boyd was wonderful.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played on all those men's pico. Pills, yeah. Pills. Yeah. And them fellows played, what you call those clarinetes? A-cranet. Well, they had different keys. Yeah. The guy going to the job, he had three or four clarinetes, man. They couldn't play in them different, just switching them different keys, you know. Oh. You ever hear Georgie Boyd playing? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Lots of good jazz clarinetes playing. What? Georgie Boyd, yeah. Oh, Georgie Boyd was wonderful. Get up there, Teddy. It's adorable. Yeah, he…
Did George Boyd, did he read music much or just mostly...? No, he didn't read much.
